en.text: Step away from the machine now.
Clip on your harness before you climb.
Midday work ban: stop outdoor work and rest in the shade.
Too hot: stop work, drink water, rest in the shade.
Put on your hi-vis vest near vehicles.
Set up shade and cold water for the crew.
Move the cable off the walkway.
Move the cord off the floor.
Put it up high, out of children's reach.
